about_the_game:
Between Two Lights is a hardcore adventure shooter set in an alternate version of 2030. The country is falling apart — a wave of murders and mysterious disappearances has become a daily routine for civilians.

You play as a state security agent working undercover as a detective. Your mission is to investigate SEC — an organization allegedly involved in trafficking organs and military tech on the black market. Officially, SEC is nothing more than a scientific research institute.

Upon arrival, things go south. The agent becomes host to a unique biomodification known as INOY-9X, granting him regenerative abilities and the power to weaponize his own Energy.

Now, he must uncover the truth behind SEC and its role in the country’s collapse. As the situation escalates, he realizes he’s just a tool in someone else's game. But not anymore — this time, it’s personal.

Explore a strange and distorted world as you travel across a broken country alongside your partner.

Your journey will be long and grueling — filled with danger, mysteries, and mind-bending sci-fi revelations. Immerse yourself in an alien reality where every dream, every frame leaves a lasting mark.

A reimagining of survival mechanics — it’s no longer about you, it’s about your Energy.

Energy is more than just a resource — it’s your shield, your damage, your path to survival. Use it to activate abilities, recover health, and even fuel certain types of advanced weaponry.

Step into Rifts — space-warping anomalies — to instantly restore all core attributes. But be warned: if your Energy hits zero, you’ll be left completely vulnerable.

Unique bosses with multiple paths to victory.

Each boss features distinct behavior patterns, multiple phases, and custom mechanics. Battles can often be resolved in more than one way — through direct damage or by manipulating the environment to your advantage.

Smart positioning and tactical awareness can lead bosses to inflict heavy damage on themselves by triggering traps or destroying critical structures.

Every encounter demands observation, adaptability, and skill. Expect anything from a quick skirmish to a drawn-out fight lasting hours — the outcome depends entirely on your approach.

name: Between Two Lights

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 2500X or Intel® Core™ i7-4930K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 Laptop / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required, Target 30 FPS / Low / Full HD
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 5600X or Intel® Core™ i5-12400F
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3070 / Nvidia GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required, Target 60 FPS / High / 2K

short_description: Between Two Lights is a hardcore shooter set in an alternate 2030. Explore a twisted world, uncover SEC's dark secrets, and survive by turning your unique Energy into a weapon, a shield, and your last hope.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Russian*, Ukrainian, Japanese
